scripts.test: bun run --filter shared build:d && bun run --filter yay test && bun run --filter renderer test
scripts.audit: bun run audit:production && bun run audit:development
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter shared build:d && bun run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter shared build:d && bun run --workspaces --if-present lint
scripts.build: bun run create-asars && bun run --workspaces build:d
scripts.package: bun run create-asars && cross-env ENV=PRODUCTION bun run build:p && cross-env ENV=PRODUCTION bun run --filter yay electron:dist
scripts.build:p: bun run clean-dist && cross-env ENV=PRODUCTION bun run --workspaces build:p
